title: CT-03 browser commands are Chrome-scoped
summary: Firefox must not consume Chrome CT-03 consent, commands or command results.
claims: Adapter identity is carried across Browser Bridge control traffic.
Chrome-scoped Desktop MCP commands are not visible to the Firefox adapter.
decision: Route CT-03 browser work to adapter=chrome and reject wrong-adapter results.
rationale: A browser-generic queue allowed whichever extension polled first to consume work.

evidence.ref: Chrome-scoped Desktop MCP cannot be consumed by the Firefox adapter
